Guidance & outlook: EML consolidated financials for the first quarter FY 26-27, our revenue, EML clocked its best ever Q1 revenue of INR 6,632 crores, marking a growth of 32% over INR 5,042 crores fiom Q1 of last year.
Our revenue for Q1 FY27 at INR6,610 crores against INR 5,671 crores of last year.
EBITDA for Q1 FY27 INR 541 crores against INR 511 crores of last year.
Growth & demand: For the quarter, VECY sales stood at 24,815 units, a growth of 14.8% and I'm very happy to inform that we continue to lead in light and medium duty trucks.
We delivered 5,275 units of Eicher heavy-duty trucks during Q1, registering 15.2% growth with market share at 8.8%.
Our exports grew very strongly by 14.7% to 1,450 units despite a challenging extemal environment.
Margins & costs: Our EBITDA, highest ever EBITDA of INR 1,591 crores versus INR 1,203 crotes in QI last year, PAT at INR 1,463 crores, up 21% from INR 1,205 crores in Q1 last year which includes INR 168 crores of EML share of profits from VECV in the corresponding quarter.
Today, the Board has approved an investment of INR1,225 crores for the Phase 1 of the greenfield expansion at Tada, which at full utilization can produce an additional 4.5 lakh motoreycles per year.
The EBITDA margin for Q1 8.4% against 9.2% of last year.
Capex & expansion: On the manufacturing front, as we gear up for the next phase of growth and to power it, we amnounced the plan for a strategic expansion of our manufacturing capacity through a new greenfield facility in Tada, Andhra Pradesh.
And the current capacity, which we are talking about, with the first module, which we have been talking about at Cheyyar, the build capacity has come to almost about 1.5 million motorcycles per year.
So the entire brownfield capacity, which will all come by financial year 27, '28, that is what we said with the Cheyyar, our production capacity will go to 2 million.
Balance sheet & cash: Any free cash which comes in, in the hands of the customers, it helps, and we'll also tweak our positioning according to that.
Risks & challenges: As we navigate global headwinds, our fundamentals remain very strong, and We are well on track to maintain our growth momentum, especially as we build inventory for the upcoming festive period.
And there's also pretty low ofhier expenses line when I look at the last couple of quarters, the significant decline in this quarter.
But the extent in the Ql as a headwind, you sce slightly it is softening.
